sources.title: Sage Academic Books - The Counseling Skills Practice Manual - Using Little Tools with Big Effect: Silence and Simple Prompts
sources.quote: Most of the work during counseling sessions should be done by your client as she explores aspects of herself and her world. You are there more as a catalyst ... and less as an expert problem solver.
sources.technique: Give the client space to explore their experience, using silence and simple prompts rather than taking over with problem-solving.

sources.title: Chapter 3—Motivational Interviewing as a Counseling Style
sources.quote: Reflective listening is fundamental to the four MI process (i.e., engaging, focusing, evoking, and planning) and core counseling strategies.
sources.technique: Use reflective listening to engage the client and explore their concerns before moving into planning.

sources.title: Deliberate Practice in Emotion-Focused Therapy
sources.quote: Exercises for Intermediate Emotion-Focused Therapy Skills: Empathic Explorations; Exercises for Advanced Emotion-Focused Therapy Skills: Staying in Contact in the Face of Intense Affect.
sources.technique: When strong emotion is present, stay in contact and use empathic exploration rather than shifting immediately to action steps.
